---
title: 'mycobank_gap'
description: 'Find fungal species with MycoBank Brazil evidence that are missing from FFB'
toc: true
toc-depth: 3
---


```{r}
#| eval: false
fungaR::mycobank_gap()
```

### Description

Given a fungal genus or order, cross-checks [MycoBank](https://www.mycobank.org)'s
global nomenclatural database against the Flora e Funga do Brasil (FFB) checklist to
find species-level names that MycoBank itself already associates with a Brazilian
locality but that are not currently registered in FFB. This is not a general diff of
the two databases: a MycoBank name missing from FFB is only returned when MycoBank's
own type/specimen locality data indicates it occurs in Brazil, so taxonomic experts get
a shortlist of genuinely plausible new national records rather than every unrelated
MycoBank name in the genus/order.

### Details

MycoBank does not offer a public search API suited to bulk automation, but it does
publish a full, regularly-updated bulk export of every name in its database
(https://www.mycobank.org/images/MBList.zip). This function downloads and caches
that export locally (the same way `funga_download` caches the FFB dataset),
then filters it down to the requested genus or order using MycoBank's own
`Classification` column.

The bulk export itself carries no locality information, so determining Brazil evidence
requires visiting each missing candidate's individual MycoBank name page (its
`MycoBank_URL`) to read the "Location details" (and "Host/Substrate") reported for
its type specimen. MycoBank's name pages are a JavaScript single-page application with
no static HTML fallback, so this step (`check_locality = TRUE`, the default)
requires the chromote package (and a local Chrome/Chromium installation) to drive
a headless browser. When `require_brazil_evidence = TRUE` (the default), the
returned table is filtered down to only the candidates whose MycoBank locality
mentions Brazil; set it to `FALSE` to instead get every MycoBank name missing from
FFB regardless of locality (with the evidence columns alongside, for manual review).
Brazil-evidence filtering has no effect if `check_locality = FALSE`, since no
locality data is available to filter on; a message explains this when it happens.

The FFB side of the comparison reuses `funga_get_children_taxa` to list every
species (accepted and synonym) currently registered in FFB for the requested genus/order.

### Arguments

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| taxon | Character. A single fungal genus or order name (e.g. `"Trichoderma"` or `"Xylariales"`). |
| rank | Character. Whether `taxon` is a `"genus"` (default) or an `"order"`. |
| check_locality | Logical. If `TRUE` (default), each MycoBank name missing from FFB has its own MycoBank name page visited (via chromote) to read the type specimen's reported locality and host/substrate, determining which candidates MycoBank itself already associates with Brazil. Set to `FALSE` to skip this (much faster, but without locality evidence, and `require_brazil_evidence` has no effect). |
| require_brazil_evidence | Logical. If `TRUE` (default), the returned table is filtered to only the candidates whose MycoBank locality mentions Brazil - i.e. names MycoBank itself indicates occur in Brazil but that FFB is still missing. Set to `FALSE` to instead return every MycoBank species-level name missing from FFB regardless of locality (with `MycoBank_Brazil_Evidence` alongside for manual review). Only meaningful when `check_locality = TRUE`. |
| max_check | Numeric. Safety cap on how many missing candidates are sent through the (comparatively slow, one-page-load-per-name) locality check when `check_locality = TRUE`. Defaults to `200`; if more candidates are found, only the first `max_check` (alphabetically) are checked and a warning is issued. Ignored when `check_locality = FALSE`. |
| version | Character. FFB dataset version to compare against. Defaults to `"latest"`. Passed to `funga_get_children_taxa`. |
| mycobank_dir | Character. Local directory used to cache the downloaded MycoBank bulk export. Defaults to `"mycobank_download"`. Reused on subsequent calls to avoid re-downloading the (~140MB) file. |
| verbose | Logical. If `TRUE` (default), prints progress messages. |
| save | Logical. If `TRUE` (default), the result is saved to disk as an `.xlsx` spreadsheet. |
| dir | Character. Directory where the spreadsheet is saved when `save = TRUE`. Defaults to `"mycobank_gap"`. |
| filename | Character. Name of the `.xlsx` file (without extension) to save. Defaults to `"mycobank_gap_<taxon>"`. |
| html_report | Logical. If `TRUE` (default), also writes a self-contained HTML report (`<dir>/<filename>.html`) summarizing the results: KPI counts, a families-affected breakdown, and the full candidate table as a sortable, filterable DT widget with buttons to copy or download it as CSV/Excel. Requires the rmarkdown, DT, and htmltools packages; if any is missing, the report is skipped with a message (the `.xlsx` spreadsheet is unaffected). |
| open_report | Logical. If `TRUE` (default in interactive sessions), opens the rendered HTML report in the default browser. |

### Value

A `data.frame`, one row per MycoBank species-level name found in the
  requested genus/order that is absent from the current FFB checklist and, by default,
  whose MycoBank locality data indicates it occurs in Brazil, with columns:

  MycoBank_NumberMycoBank's numeric identifier for the name.
  Taxon_nameThe binomial as registered in MycoBank.
  AuthorsFull author citation.
  YearYear of effective publication.
  Name_statusMycoBank's nomenclatural status (e.g. `"Legitimate"`).
  ClassificationFull MycoBank classification string (Kingdom to genus).
  Current_nameMycoBank's currently accepted name for this entry, when different
    (i.e. when `Taxon_name` is itself a synonym).
  SynonymyMycoBank's full synonymy text (current name and/or basionym, each with
    its complete author/journal/year citation), from the bulk export.
  MycoBank_URLDirect link to the name's MycoBank page.
  MycoBank_Locality, MycoBank_SubstrateType specimen locality and host/substrate
    as reported on the name's own MycoBank page (only when `check_locality = TRUE`).
  MycoBank_EtymologyThe name's etymology, as reported on its own MycoBank page
    (only when `check_locality = TRUE`).
  MycoBank_Name_TypeMycoBank's nomenclatural name type for this entry (e.g.
    `"Basionym"`, `"Combination"`; only when `check_locality = TRUE`).
  MycoBank_Type_SpecimenThe type specimen voucher (e.g. `"URM 80362
    holotype"`; only when `check_locality = TRUE`).
  MycoBank_CollectorThe type specimen's collector, as reported on the name's own
    MycoBank page (only when `check_locality = TRUE`).
  MycoBank_ProtologThe original-publication (protolog) citation, as reported on
    the name's own MycoBank page (only when `check_locality = TRUE`).
  MycoBank_Brazil_EvidenceLogical; `TRUE` when `MycoBank_Locality`
    mentions Brazil (only when `check_locality = TRUE`).
  In_FFBAlways `FALSE` (kept for clarity when combining with other tables).

### Examples

```r
# Species-level MycoBank names for genus Trichoderma that MycoBank's own
# locality data places in Brazil but that are still missing from FFB
gap <- mycobank_gap(taxon = "Trichoderma", rank = "genus")

# Every MycoBank name missing from FFB regardless of locality, for manual review
gap_all <- mycobank_gap(taxon = "Trichoderma", rank = "genus",
                              require_brazil_evidence = FALSE)

# Faster, without the locality check (no Brazil-evidence filtering possible)
gap_fast <- mycobank_gap(taxon = "Trichoderma", rank = "genus",
                               check_locality = FALSE)
```
